title: 夕焼け小焼け (Yuyake Koyake — Sunset Glow)
description: One of Japan's most nostalgic songs about the end of the day. As the sunset glows and temple bells ring in the mountains, children hold hands and walk home together with the crows. The moon rises large and round, small birds dream in their nests, and golden stars begin to glitter in the sky. The melody is still broadcast through outdoor loudspeakers in many Japanese towns at 5pm as a signal for children to come home.
